newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-SECOND CAPS FOR FORWARDS LABROUSSE AND MIORIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SECOND CAPS FOR FORWARDS LABROUSSE AND MIORIN.

text.p: French selectors on Saturday named number eight Thierry Labrousse, one of the stars in the French Barbarians' victory over South Africa, in their side for next weekend's first test against the Springboks in Bordeaux.

The Brive forward, who helped the Barbarians to a 30-22 win on Saturday, and Toulouse lock Hugues Miorin, who gets his chance in place of injured Olivier Roumat, will win their second caps after playing against Romania in April.
Both players toured Argentina in June but neither played in the tests, Labrousse missing all the tour matches because of injury.
World Cup flanker Abdelatif Benazzi will captain the French side next Saturday in the absence of wing Philippe Saint-Andre, one of several injured regulars.

Dax fullback Richard Dourthe, who has previously played for France at centre, replaces Emile Ntamack on one wing with Stephane Glas coming in at centre, while David Berty takes Saint-Andre's place on the other.
The second and final test is in Paris on December 7.

Team: 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny; 14-Richard Dourthe, 13-Stephane Glas, 12-Thomas Castaignede, 11-David Berty; 10-Alain Penaud, 9-Philippe Carbonneau; 8-Thierry Labrousse, 7-Abdelatif Benazzi (captain), 6-Philippe Benetton, 5-Fabien Pelous, 4-Hugues Miorin, 3-Franck Tournaire, 2-Marc de Rougemont, 1-Christian Califano.
